svg.aria-label: A Bloom filter is a bit array plus several hash functions. Adding "alice" sets the bits at positions given by three hashes, 2, 7 and 11. Checking "bob" looks at his three positions; one of them is 0, so bob was definitely never added. Checking a key whose positions are all 1 answers probably yes, because other keys may have set those bits.

svg.text: ~10 bits per item ≈ 1% false "yes" · never a false "no"
